title: Kewan Lacy and Malachi Toney Team Up with Turtle Beach for a Seriously Unserious Experiment
summary: Ole Miss's Kewan Lacy and Miami's Malachi Toney put the Stealth Ultra controller through a field test. Watch the clip and see what control means.
body_markdown:
As elite college football athletes and[Stealth Ultra](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-ultra-controller) controller ambassadors, Kewan Lacy and Malachi Toney know how important it is to be in control of your game.


A new collaboration with Turtle Beach sees the Ole Miss running back and Miami Hurricanes wide receiver put the Stealth Ultra to the ultimate field test. They not only run the controller through its paces, but they also run our poor researcher into the turf. Several times.


That’s how seriously we take engineering the best controllers.


Now watch the clip and get back to me.


> [View this post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdeY2TXuw84/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)
>
>
> [A post shared by Turtle Beach (@turtlebeach)](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdeY2TXuw84/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)


Okay, you did it? Good. You’ve gotten just a taste of what it means to truly be in control.


That’s because the Stealth Ultra features AntiDrift™ thumbsticks for precision movements, tactile microswitches for fast, reliable responsiveness, and a dynamic, full-color Command Display dashboard that so you have equal control of both your comms and your actions.


Whether you’re catching passes or catching up with your friends, the Stealth Ultra controller puts you in ultimate control of your game – perfect for both the most serious and most unserious gamers.


In the wise words of Mali: “Game ain’t based on sympathy.”


It’s based on[control](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-ultra-controller) .
